description: File an abuse report against an address that attacked a system you run. Needs an API key. Use category codes from list_categories (e.g. ssh,brute-force) and put the evidence (log lines, never personal data) in the comment. Each reporter can report the same address once per 15 minutes. Only report real, observed abuse.

categories.description: Comma-separated category codes or numeric IDs, e.g. ssh,brute-force

comment.description: Evidence: what happened, ideally the relevant log lines

ip.description: The attacking IPv4 or IPv6 address

timestamp.description: When the attack happened, ISO 8601 (optional, defaults to now)

name: report_ip
title: Report an abusive IP address
